contradicting_evidence: BTC remains positive over the observed 24h window, and both BTC and ETH improved since the prior packet.
Breadth improved modestly rather than deteriorating further, although the observations belong to the same upstream family and are not independent votes.
Stablecoin supply remains modestly positive over 30 days, and sentiment is neutral rather than evidence of acute stress.
One negative settled ETF session does not establish the direction of subsequent sessions.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A fading rebound or renewed downside retest is modestly favored, particularly for ETH and the observed alt universe. BTC may outperform without transmitting strength broadly. This is a low-conviction directional bias, not a forecast of an uninterrupted or severe decline.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH recovery with ETH/BTC strengthening and broader participation would invalidate the failed-rebound thesis.
Improving subsequent settled ETF flows alongside persistent spot gains and stronger breadth would undermine the proposed downside transmission.
If the initial weakness is absorbed and prices subsequently advance with wider participation, absorption would have developed into recovery rather than merely stabilization.
missing_evidence: There is no sequence of upcoming settled ETF sessions demonstrating whether outflows persist or reverse.
The supplied derivatives evidence covers too little time to establish sustained leverage accumulation or deleveraging.
No liquidation, options-positioning or multi-session spot-flow evidence establishes the potential magnitude of a retest.
supporting_evidence: Breadth is weak, with a 0.26 advance ratio and a negative aggregate median return; capitalization-proxy medians are negative across all observed alt buckets.
ETH/BTC weakened in the latest hour and since the prior packet, providing no confirmation that BTC resilience is reaching ETH.
Latest settled ETF flows were negative for both BTC (-82.4 million reported USD) and ETH (-69.7 million reported USD).
Stablecoin supply contracted approximately 0.48% over seven days and 0.08% over one day; this is a modest liquidity headwind, not evidence of confirmed selling or deployment.
Only 35% of the 30d altseason universe outperformed BTC, reinforcing the absence of broad short-window relative strength.
